Class PlayerPayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.PlayerPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerPayload extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a snapshot/summary of a single player's personal state in the game.

This contains the player's nickname, resource counts (food and prestige points), totem identifier, current tribe cards, and network connection status.
